job.title: Lead Product Data Scientist, Forecasting
job.pay_full: $172,000 – $258,000 a year base pay range across US locations

details.about: Klaviyo's Product Data Science team works with Product, Engineering, Finance and Go-to-Market teams to turn complex data into insights for product strategy, financial planning and growth. This hands-on technical leadership role owns and advances Klaviyo's forecasting capabilities, from revenue models to the standards that make forecasting a trusted practice across the company.
duties: Own revenue forecasting end to end, from problem framing through deployment and monitoring

Build forecasting models across time horizons and levels of granularity using hierarchical, probabilistic and Bayesian methods, classical time series, machine learning and time series foundation models
Define how the organization measures accuracy, bias, calibration and uncertainty
Lead the technical direction of forecasting: evaluate approaches, review designs and mentor data scientists
Support scenario planning and strategic investment decisions with Product, Finance, Engineering and Go-to-Market
Lead root cause investigations when results diverge from forecasts, and build repeatable frameworks for them
Develop self-service forecasting and analytics capabilities
Work with Data Engineering on reliable data pipelines and dbt models
Evaluate emerging AI and forecasting technologies
Communicate statistical findings clearly, up to executive leadership
needs: 10+ years in data science, product analytics, applied statistics or a related quantitative discipline, with significant hands-on experience deploying forecasting solutions in production
Deep expertise in time series forecasting, statistical modeling and model evaluation
Highly proficient in SQL and Python or R, with familiarity with dbt and modern analytics engineering
Technical leadership: setting direction, mentoring data scientists and influencing standards
Statistical rigor combined with strong business intuition
Ability to explain sophisticated statistical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior executives
An AI-first mindset, with familiarity around time series foundation models, LLMs and agentic tools

A degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, Engineering or another quantitative discipline, or an MBA with a quantitative emphasis; equivalent hands-on experience in applied forecasting or statistical modeling is equally valued
nice: Scaling forecasting in a high-growth B2B SaaS or product-focused technology company
Revenue forecasting, financial modeling or scenario planning in a subscription business
Cloud data platforms, distributed processing and modern data engineering infrastructure
Mixed effects models, clustering and probabilistic modeling for customer behavior and product performance
Building self-service analytics tools, dashboards or forecasting platforms
Establishing forecasting governance, model evaluation frameworks or standardized root cause analysis
details.benefits: Base pay range for US locations $172,000 – $258,000 a year; the offer depends on job-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location. Total compensation may include the annual cash bonus plan, equity, sign-on payments and a comprehensive range of health, welfare and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility.
notes: May require up to 10% travel, coordinated in advance
Klaviyo says it will never ask for payment, bank details or personal financial information during the application process

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, and it owns the company's forecasting work, connecting statistical methods to real business questions.

bullets: Own revenue forecasting end to end

You'll also build self-service tools for product leaders, work with data engineering on pipelines, and mentor other data scientists.
